basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Seattle, I'm a 30-year-old software developer who spends evenings and weekends diving into gaming worlds. Destiny 2 is my go-to game, where I love experimenting with different weapon rolls and strategies. When I'm not gaming, you might catch me at a King Gizzard concert or exploring geopolitical documentaries about North Korea. I usually browse Reddit late at night, post-dinner, and sometimes during lunch breaks at work. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it brings to indulge in my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since high school, with a particular passion for first-person shooters and RPGs. My knowledge of Destiny 2 has been built up over years of playing and participating in online communities. I also have a keen interest in geopolitics, which I explore through documentaries and reading, particularly focused on North Korea.
